text: Winamax, the Stade Rennais back-of-shirt sponsor, is a French online poker and sports-betting operator based in Paris (SIREN 492155932, SA, registered 2006) whose shareholders and founders are Alexandre Roos and Christophe Schaming, per the company's own 'À propos' page; the registry lists both men as dirigeants. The company was financed in 2010 by a €12m round with Idinvest Partners but control has stayed with the founders; no state or sovereign-fund stake was found in the chain.
short: Winamax SA is a private French operator owned by its founders Alexandre Roos and Christophe Schaming.

source.name: Winamax — À propos de la société Winamax (winamax.fr)
source.quote: Ses actionnaires et fondateurs, Alexandre Roos, Christophe Schaming (Lycos, Caramail), ont associé leur savoir-faire autour de l’internet communautaire et de l’industrie du jeu en ligne.
